::: {.callout-note}
## About this template

Every chapter in this project is placeholder content. The text shows the conventions of a DLM technical manual, and all data are simulated so that each table, figure, and cross-reference renders in both formats. Replace these files with the chapters of your report.
:::

## How to read this manual {.unnumbered}

Chapters follow the structure of the validity argument. @sec-overview describes the purpose of the system and the intended uses of results. @sec-design documents how items and testlets are written and reviewed. @sec-modeling describes the diagnostic classification models used to score the assessment, and @sec-reliability summarizes the reliability evidence. Supplemental tables appear in the appendices.
